text: Binary flag from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it): 1 if at least one comment offers a logical refutation of the OP's view (argument from reasoning, logic, consistency, or definitions) AND no comment contains specific empirical evidence (concrete data, statistics, studies, documented real-world cases, or specific factual observations, including specific personal experience). 0 if any comment contains such empirical evidence, or if no comment offers a logical refutation; empty list -> 0. Missing or malformed input -> null. Comment order is irrelevant. Ignore OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules counts neither as evidence nor is excluded.
